title: 第9章 冰煞姣内丹第10章 符箓
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
百年灵植能够炼制出一品丹药。
五百年灵植能够炼制出二品丹药。
千年灵植能够炼制出三品丹药。
李蒙本想炼制二品淬灵丹。
可惜灵植园没有两百年以上年份的灵植。
一个时辰后。
“起炉！”
李蒙双手掐诀。
浑身冒出的灵光突然散去了。
十一颗雪白的丹药飞出了炼丹炉。
李蒙手中拿着一个玉瓶。
无瑕淬灵丹飞入了玉瓶中。
奇异浓郁的药香扑鼻。
整个小竹峰都飘荡着一股浓郁的丹香。
好在小竹峰地处偏僻。
否则不知会引起的骚乱。
要知道无瑕丹药可是丹中之王。
哪怕一品无瑕丹药都是有价无市的珍宝。
不仅药力是上等丹药的数倍。
而且不会残留任何丹毒。

在隔壁的卧室中，床上盘坐着一道曼妙身影。
曲柔早就来了。
见那个外门弟子正在炼丹便没有打扰。
扑鼻而来的浓郁药香让曲柔睁开了双眼。
一双眼眸异彩涟涟。
竟然是无瑕丹药？
“没想到李师侄还真有几分本事，可惜了……”
哪怕是九品炼丹师也很难炼制出一品无瑕丹药。
因为世间本就不存在无瑕之物。
想要达到无瑕，与修为高低没有关系。
而是一种无法言语的意境。
当炼丹师进入那种与天地契合玄奥的意境时才有可能炼制出无瑕丹药。
而李师侄炼制无瑕丹药就好像喝水那般简单。
这要是传到丹药堂，丹王峰的那位太上长老恐怕也会被吓一大跳。
可惜李师侄的资质实在是太差。
content_en:
Bai Lingzhi can refine a first-grade elixir.
Five hundred years of spiritual cultivation can refine second-grade elixirs.
Thousand-year-old spiritual plants can refine third-grade elixirs.
Li Meng originally wanted to refine the second-grade Spirit Tempering Pill.
It is a pity that there are no spiritual plants in the spiritual plant garden that are more than 200 years old.
An hour later.
"Start the stove!"
Li Meng made a hand gesture.
The aura that appeared all over his body suddenly dissipated.
Eleven snow-white pills flew out of the alchemy furnace.
Li Meng held a jade bottle in his hand.
The flawless spirit tempering pill flew into the jade bottle.
The strange and rich medicinal fragrance hits your nose.
The entire Xiaozhu Peak is filled with a strong fragrance of red dandelion.
Fortunately, Xiaozhu Peak is located in a remote area.
Otherwise, I don’t know what kind of commotion it would cause.
You must know that the flawless elixir is the king of elixirs.
Even a flawless elixir is a priceless treasure.
Not only is the potency several times that of the best elixirs.
And no erysipelas will remain.
In the bedroom next door, a graceful figure sat cross-legged on the bed.
Qu Rou has been here a long time ago.
Seeing that the outer disciple was refining elixir, he didn't bother him.
The strong medicinal fragrance that hit her nostrils made Qu Rou open her eyes.
A pair of bright eyes.
It turned out to be a flawless elixir?
"I didn't expect Junior Nephew Li to be quite capable. It's a pity..."
Even a ninth-grade alchemist would find it difficult to refine a first-grade flawless elixir.
Because there is no flawless thing in the world.
If you want to achieve flawlessness, it has nothing to do with your level of cultivation.
Rather, it is an artistic conception that cannot be expressed in words.
Only when the alchemist enters that mysterious state of mind that is in harmony with heaven and earth can he be able to refine flawless elixirs.
For Master Nephew Li, refining the flawless elixir is as simple as drinking water.
If this were to spread to the Pill Hall, the Supreme Elder at the Pill King Peak would probably be shocked.
It's a pity that Master Nephew Li's qualifications are really poor.
